summary: Recreation.gov listing live, bookable all winter. Confirmed fees $7.50-15 (off-peak/peak, not a discount; re-sourced), electric 0 (derived -> manual) plus no water/sewer. Added vault toilets, seasonal drinking water, no showers/dump, 22 RV-usable sites (max 99 ft, 1 pull-through), recreation.gov booking, year-round season. Phone 706-745-6928 confirmed as the Blue Ridge RD's new main line. Note kept.
flags: Two loops, one entry (not a split): Cooper Creek Loop and Mulky Loop centroids are 615 m apart (recreation.gov site coordinates), under the ~1 km split threshold, and booked as one facility; the note's 'about 700 m apart' is close.

Pin 34.76295,-84.06815 sits on the Cooper Creek Loop (42 m from its site centroid; Mulky Loop is 573 m WSW at ~34.7615,-84.0742). The combined site centroid (34.7624,-84.0706) falls between the loops, so the pin is fine as is.
Site 7 is listed for RVs but its driveway is 10 ft - not counted.
